# Tech Miss3

> Tech Miss3 is an Udyam-registered IT solutions company that builds AI-based business automation, responsive websites, and mobile apps (Android/iOS) for small and medium businesses. It also builds and maintains its own product, PointScheduler.

Tech Miss3 works as a digital business solution partner rather than a one-off vendor: every engagement includes a discovery call, a clear scope, timeline and quote agreed before work starts, design, development and QA, and post-launch support.

## Services
- AI Based Business Solutions — workflow automation, chatbots/virtual assistants, forecasting and analytics, document processing: https://techmiss3.com/ai-based-business-solutions.html
- Website Development — custom, responsive, SEO-friendly websites, web applications, and e-commerce/CMS integrations: https://techmiss3.com/website-development.html
- Mobile App Development — native Android/iOS and Flutter cross-platform apps, Play Store/App Store launch support: https://techmiss3.com/mobile-app-development.html

## Products
- PointScheduler — therapy centre management software built by Tech Miss3, covering scheduling, patient records, therapist rosters, session notes, packages and billing, across web and mobile: https://techmiss3.com/pointscheduler.html
- Introductory PointScheduler trial: ₹99 for 15 days.
- The website describes mobile app access for the therapy team and shows a mobile therapist-app preview. The separate guardian-facing PointScheduler Parent App is marked Coming Soon/in development; its described features are not presented as currently available.

## Technologies
AI/ML, Node.js, React, Flutter, Java, Android, Kotlin, Jenkins, Git, cloud deployment tooling.

- Udyam-registered MSME (India)
